decisive_items: Brain Biopsy (left frontal lesion): CD5− CD10− CD19+ CD20+ BCL6+ MUM-1+ EBV/EBER−
Cerebrospinal fluid: Presence of lymphoma cells
Fluorescence in situ hybridization: Extra copies of BCL6 (3q27) and BCL2 (18q21), no MYC abnormalities
response.rationale: Biopsy shows a mature B-cell lymphoma immunophenotype and CSF contains lymphoma cells; extensive nonenhancing CNS involvement with negative marrow supports primary CNS lymphoma. The FISH gains are supportive molecular features but do not define a separate diagnosis.

rejected.why: Biopsy immunophenotype indicates B-cell lymphoma, not a glial tumor; nonenhancement alone is nonspecific.
Biopsy and CSF show lymphoma, not viral demyelination; MRI white-matter pattern is not specific for PML.
CSF lymphoma cells and B-cell biopsy make demyelinating disease such as MS untenable.
Nonspecific leukoencephalopathy description is contradicted by the definitive lymphoma findings on biopsy and CSF.
CSF lymphoma cells suggest leptomeningeal involvement, but the parenchymal left frontal biopsy and extensive brain MRI indicate primary CNS lymphoma rather than isolated meningitis.
